title: Rich media
description: Image or video, chosen with a content palette (object). The image options copy partials/media's fields (a test keeps them identical).

oneOf.title: Image — media library
oneOf.description: Pick from the Amplience media library, with crop and point of interest.

image.title: Image
image.description: Pick from the Amplience media library. Use the crop and POI handles to set framing.

aspectLock.title: Crop aspect ratio
aspectLock.description: Aspect ratio used when resizing the crop rectangle, e.g. "16:9". "none" unlocks aspect.

query.title: DI query string
query.description: Pre-baked DI transform params (crop, POI, smart scaling). Appended to the base URL by the renderer.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of the DELIVERED image in pixels (crop applied when drawn). Written by the extension so consumers can reserve layout space without a second call.

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of the DELIVERED image in pixels (crop applied when drawn). Written by the extension so consumers can reserve layout space without a second call.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio (width / height) of the delivered image: the crop rectangle when a crop is active, otherwise the source image. Bind directly to CSS aspect-ratio to avoid layout shift (CLS).

imageAltText.title: Image Alt Text
imageAltText.description: Auto-populated from the media library asset for the current locale. Override here if needed.

oneOf.title: Image — URL
oneOf.description: Enter an image URL and its dimensions.

aspectRatio.title: CSS aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Optional layout override e.g. "16 / 9" (CSS slash format).

oneOf.title: Video — media library
oneOf.description: Pick a video from the Amplience media library.

video.title: Video
video.description: Pick from the Amplience media library.

poster.title: Poster image
poster.description: Optional. Shown before the video plays. Defaults to the video's own thumbnail.

title.title: Video title
title.description: Short description for screen readers. Not needed for ambient videos, which are treated as decoration.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Shape of the video frame. Reserves the space before the video loads, so there is no layout shift.

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: player — click to play, with controls and sound. ambient — plays automatically, muted and looping, with no controls: for adding movement to a page. Ambient videos show a pause button and don't autoplay for visitors who prefer reduced motion. A video in a hero always plays as ambient; one inside a link is ambient too, and plays only while the link is hovered or focused.

oneOf.title: Video — YouTube, Vimeo or .mp4
oneOf.description: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or a direct .mp4 URL.

url.title: Video URL
url.description: A YouTube or Vimeo link (any share, watch or embed URL), or a direct link to an .mp4 file.

title.title: Video title
title.description: Short description for screen readers — required for embedded players.

posterUrl.title: Poster image URL
posterUrl.description: Optional. An https image URL shown before the video plays. YouTube thumbnails are used automatically.

aspectRatio.title: Aspect ratio
aspectRatio.description: Shape of the video frame. Reserves the space before the video loads, so there is no layout shift.

Ambient videos show a pause button and don't autoplay for visitors who prefer reduced motion.
